#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Materialize an exact following SCF source selection from the existing publisher's full carrier."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

OPERATION = "SCF-GRANT-CURRENT-REVIEW-81CF-20261012"
PHASE = "SCF-SUBMISSION-SOURCE-PACKAGE-A8CE-20261012"
DIST = "stellar-forge/developer-site/dist/"
ROLES = {"application": "application.md", "source-index": "source-index.json",
         "budget": "budget.csv", "product-and-finance": "product-and-finance.md"}

def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()

def blob(body):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\0" + body).hexdigest()

def source_bytes(row):
    content = row["content"]
    if not isinstance(content, str):
        raise ValueError("Retain a complete encoded source string: " + row["path"])
    encoding = row.get("encoding", "utf-8")
    if encoding in (None, "utf-8"):
        return content.encode("utf-8")
    if encoding == "base64":
        body = base64.b64decode(content, validate=True)
        if base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii") != content:
            raise ValueError("Retain canonical complete base64 source: " + row["path"])
        return body
    raise ValueError("Select UTF-8 or base64 source encoding: " + row["path"])

def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

def exact_path(value):
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (not value or "\\" in value or "\0" in value or path.is_absolute() or
            ".." in path.parts or str(path) != value):
        raise ValueError("Select an exact source-relative path.")
    return path

def commit(value):
    if len(value) != 40 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value):
        raise ValueError("Select the actual full immutable commit identity.")
    return value

def selected_bytes(path, expected):
    if not path.is_absolute() or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Select an existing absolute local input: " + str(path))
    body = path.read_bytes()
    if sha(body) != expected:
        raise ValueError("The complete selected input differs: " + str(path))
    return body

def write(path, body):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    with path.open("xb") as output:
        output.write(body)
    path.chmod(0o600)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source-packet", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-packet-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-package", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-package-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--original-source-commit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--runtime-source-commit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--application-source-commit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    os.umask(0o077)
    for name in ("original_source_commit", "runtime_source_commit", "application_source_commit"):
        commit(getattr(args, name))
    if not args.output.is_absolute() or args.output.exists():
        raise ValueError("Choose an unused absolute directory for this complete publisher selection.")
    source_body = selected_bytes(args.source_packet, args.source_packet_sha256)
    package_body = selected_bytes(args.source_package, args.source_package_sha256)
    source = json.loads(source_body)
    packet = json.loads(package_body)
    if not isinstance(source.get("files"), list) or not source["files"]:
        raise ValueError("Use the original publisher's complete files/content source carrier.")
    selected = {}
    for row in source["files"]:
        name = str(exact_path(row["path"]))
        if name in selected:
            raise ValueError("Retain each complete source member once: " + name)
        body = source_bytes(row)
        metadata = {"path": name, "bytes": len(body), "sha256": sha(body), "git_blob": blob(body)}
        if (any(row.get(key) != metadata[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")) or
                row.get("gitBlob", metadata["git_blob"]) != metadata["git_blob"]):
            raise ValueError("The complete publisher source body differs: " + name)
        selected[name] = (metadata, body)
    received = packet.get("received", {})
    bundle = received.get("bundle", {}).get("body", {})
    files = bundle.get("files", [])
    if len(files) != 4 or {row.get("role") for row in files} != set(ROLES):
        raise ValueError("Select all four complete files in the original reviewer source package.")
    objects = {}
    for row in received.get("objects", []):
        if row["sha256"] in objects:
            raise ValueError("Retain each complete reviewer source object once.")
        objects[row["sha256"]] = row
    source_records = None
    for row in files:
        if row["name"] != ROLES[row["role"]]:
            raise ValueError("Retain the original complete reviewer file names.")
        stored = objects[row["sha256"]]
        body = base64.b64decode(stored["base64"], validate=True)
        if len(body) != row["bytes"] or len(body) != stored["bytes"] or sha(body) != row["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The complete selected reviewer object differs: " + row["name"])
        name = DIST + "grant-data/" + row["name"]
        if name not in selected or selected[name][1] != body:
            raise ValueError("The publisher source and selected reviewer package differ: " + name)
        if row["role"] == "source-index":
            index = json.loads(body)
            ids = [item["id"] for item in index["sources"]]
            if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
                raise ValueError("Keep the actual complete source index with unique original source IDs.")
            source_records = len(ids)
    required = (
        DIST + "grant.html", DIST + "grant-submission.html",
        DIST + "grant-submission-workspace.mjs", DIST + "grant-submission-core.mjs",
        DIST + "grant-handover-source.mjs", DIST + "grant-review-round-core.mjs",
        DIST + "grant-review-round-workspace.mjs", DIST + "drafts.mjs",
        "stellar-forge/developer-site/grant-export.mjs",
    )
    if any(name not in selected for name in required):
        raise ValueError("Receive the publisher's full reader, editor, review and original exporter source.")
    assets = [selected[name][0] for name in sorted(selected)]
    manifest = {
        "schema": "stellar-forge.current-source-assets-selection.v1",
        "operationId": OPERATION, "phaseId": PHASE,
        "originalSourceCommit": args.original_source_commit,
        "currentRuntimeSourceCommit": args.runtime_source_commit,
        "currentApplicationSourceCommit": args.application_source_commit,
        "sourcePackage": {"bytes": len(package_body), "sha256": sha(package_body),
                          "sourceRecords": source_records},
        "readerPath": DIST + "grant.html", "assets": assets,
        "sourceCarrier": {"bytes": len(source_body), "sha256": sha(source_body),
                          "sourceCommit": source.get("sourceCommit")},
    }
    args.output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for name, (_, body) in selected.items():
        write(args.output / "source" / name, body)
    write(args.output / "source-package.json", package_body)
    manifest_body = encoded(manifest)
    write(args.output / "source-selection.json", manifest_body)
    result = {
        "schema": "stellar-forge.following-source-selection.v1",
        "operationId": OPERATION, "sourceFiles": len(assets),
        "sourceRecords": source_records,
        "sourceCarrier": manifest["sourceCarrier"],
        "sourcePackage": manifest["sourcePackage"],
        "sourceSelection": {"path": str(args.output / "source-selection.json"),
                            "bytes": len(manifest_body), "sha256": sha(manifest_body)},
        "sourceRoot": str(args.output / "source"),
        "readerHTML": str(args.output / "source" / manifest["readerPath"]),
    }
    write(args.output / "RESULT.json", encoded(result))
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Finish the retained SCF review from its complete saved receiving case."""
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
import zipfile

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from scf_native_process import (
    preserve_console, record_runtime_selection, retain_runtime_edition, run_receiving_program,
)

OPERATION = "SCF-GRANT-CURRENT-REVIEW-81CF-20261012"

def digest(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()

def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".new")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    temporary.chmod(0o600)
    temporary.replace(path)

def relative_path(raw):
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw or "\\" in raw or "\0" in raw:
        raise ValueError("Invalid case member")
    selected = PurePosixPath(raw)
    if selected.is_absolute() or ".." in selected.parts or str(selected) != raw:
        raise ValueError("Invalid case member: " + raw)
    return selected

def file_digest(path):
    selected = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for piece in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            selected.update(piece)
    return selected.hexdigest()

def unpack_case(archive, destination, native_review=False, additional_members=()):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
        members = bundle.infolist()
        names = [row.filename for row in members]
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError("The complete case contains duplicate member paths")
        selected_names = None
        if native_review:
            config = json.loads(bundle.read("config.json"))
            selected_names = {str(relative_path(name)) for name in additional_members}
            selected_names.update({"config.json", "review-continuation-native.json",
                              "review-continuation-config.json", "runtime-selection.json"})
            selected_names.update("source/" + str(relative_path(row["path"])) for row in config["files"])
            if config.get("retainedReviewPath"):
                selected_names.add(str(relative_path(config["retainedReviewPath"])))
            else:
                selected_names.add("source/" + str(relative_path(config["originalReviewPath"])))
            selected_names.update(("receiving/downloads/Current_Complete_Submission.json",
                "receiving/saved-submission-record.json", "receiving/application/RESULT.json",
                "receiving/companion/companion-receiving.json"))
            selected_names.update("receiving/review-continuation/" + name for name in (
                "Current_Review_Checkpoint.json", "native-process.log", "progress.json",
                "INCOMPLETE.json", "Failure.html", "RESULT.json", "prepared-native-progress.json",
                "PREPARED_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE.json", "prepared-native-review-record.json",
                "native-process.json", "javascript-parse.log", "node-version.log",
                "browser-version.log", "independent-native-receiving.log", "producer-console.log"))
        materialized = 0
        for item in members:
            relative = relative_path(item.filename.rstrip("/") if item.is_dir() else item.filename)
            mode = (item.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
            if mode not in (0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR):
                raise ValueError("The complete case must contain ordinary source files")
            if selected_names is not None and item.filename not in selected_names and not item.filename.startswith("runtime/"):
                continue
            target = destination.joinpath(*relative.parts)
            if item.is_dir():
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
                continue
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
            with target.open("xb") as out:
                with bundle.open(item) as inp:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(inp, out)
            target.chmod(0o600)
            materialized += 1
    return len(members), materialized

def archive_case(original, case, archive, output, retired):
    replacements = {}
    for file in sorted(case.rglob("*")):
        if file.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("The retained case must contain ordinary files")
        if file.is_file():
            if file.is_relative_to(output / "captures") or file.name == "Failure.png":
                continue
            replacements[file.relative_to(case).as_posix()] = file
    with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as retained:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "x", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as bundle:
            for item in retained.infolist():
                if item.filename in replacements or item.filename in retired:
                    continue
                if item.is_dir():
                    bundle.writestr(copy.copy(item), b"")
                    continue
                with retained.open(item) as inp:
                    with bundle.open(copy.copy(item), "w") as out:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(inp, out, 1024 * 1024)
            for name, file in replacements.items():
                bundle.write(file, name)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as retained, zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as complete:
        incoming, final = set(retained.namelist()), set(complete.namelist())
        expected = {retired.get(name, name) for name in incoming}
        if not expected.issubset(final) or len(final) != len(complete.namelist()):
            raise ValueError("Retain every original member in the complete continued case")
        for original_name, history_name in retired.items():
            if original_name not in incoming:
                raise ValueError("An archived prior attempt must name its original member")
            before, after = retained.getinfo(original_name), complete.getinfo(history_name)
            if (before.file_size, before.CRC) != (after.file_size, after.CRC):
                raise ValueError("The original attempt changed while moving to history: " + original_name)



def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--case", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-case-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--parent", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--node", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--engine", choices=("browser", "native"), default="browser")
    parser.add_argument("--source-input", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-source-input-sha256")
    parser.add_argument("--node-modules", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--chromium", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=int, default=900)
    parser.add_argument("--save-library", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--replace-library-file-id")
    parser.add_argument("--expected-library-version", type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    os.umask(0o077)
    if not 60 <= args.timeout_seconds <= 3600:
        raise ValueError("Choose a timeout from 60 to 3600 seconds")
    if bool(args.replace_library_file_id) != (args.expected_library_version is not None):
        raise ValueError("A replacement requires the exact original file ID and current version")
    if args.expected_library_version is not None and args.expected_library_version < 0:
        raise ValueError("Select an existing Library version")
    if bool(args.source_input) != bool(args.expected_source_input_sha256):
        raise ValueError("A complete source input requires its selected SHA-256.")
    if args.source_input and args.engine != "native":
        raise ValueError("Continue the current source package through the native receiving engine.")
    selected_paths = [args.case, args.parent, args.node]
    if args.source_input:
        selected_paths.append(args.source_input)
    if args.engine == "browser":
        if args.node_modules is None or args.chromium is None:
            raise ValueError("The browser engine requires --node-modules and --chromium")
        selected_paths.extend((args.node_modules, args.chromium))
    for selected in selected_paths:
        if not selected.is_absolute() or not selected.exists():
            raise ValueError("Supply existing absolute input and runtime paths: " + str(selected))
    if not args.case.is_file() or not args.parent.is_dir() or (args.engine == "browser" and not args.node_modules.is_dir()):
        raise ValueError("Select the complete saved ZIP and actual host directories")
    selected_hash = file_digest(args.case)
    original_case_bytes = args.case.stat().st_size
    if selected_hash != args.expected_case_sha256:
        raise ValueError("The complete case differs from the selected saved version")
    if args.source_input:
        from receive_source import receive_source
        return receive_source(args, sys.modules[__name__])

    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="scf-review-continuation-", dir=args.parent))
    case, private, temporary = root / "case", root / "private", root / "tmp"
    for directory in (case, private, temporary):
        directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    preserve_console(root / "producer-console.log")
    print("SCF_REVIEW_CASE_PREPARE " + json.dumps({"root": str(root), "engine": args.engine}), flush=True)
    members, materialized = unpack_case(args.case, case, native_review=args.engine == "native")
    runtime, previous = case / "runtime", case / "receiving"
    output = previous / "review-continuation"
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    config = json.loads((case / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not config.get("files") or not config.get("reviewDecisions") or not config.get("reviewResolutions"):
        raise ValueError("The case does not include its selected source and substantive review")
    for selected in (previous / "downloads/Current_Complete_Submission.json",
                     previous / "saved-submission-record.json",
                     previous / "application/RESULT.json",
                     previous / "companion/companion-receiving.json"):
        if not selected.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Continue the original complete reader and saved draft: " + str(selected))

    attempt = output / "attempts" / (time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime()) + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8])
    retired = {}

    def retain_attempt(source, name):
        if source.is_file():
            attempt.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
            target = attempt / name
            retired[source.relative_to(case).as_posix()] = target.relative_to(case).as_posix()
            source.replace(target)

    retained = (
        "native-process.log", "native-process.json", "progress.json", "INCOMPLETE.json",
        "Failure.html", "RESULT.json", "javascript-parse.log", "node-version.log",
        "browser-version.log", "producer-console.log", "independent-native-receiving.log",
        "prepared-native-progress.json", "PREPARED_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE.json",
        "prepared-native-review-record.json",
    )
    for name in retained:
        retain_attempt(output / name, name)
    retain_attempt(case / "review-continuation-native.json", "native-result.json")
    retain_attempt(case / "review-continuation-config.json", "review-continuation-config.json")
    retain_attempt(case / "runtime-selection.json", "runtime-selection.json")
    # Both engines continue the same complete checkpoint and its matching decisions.
    preceding_runtime = retain_runtime_edition(runtime, case)
    runtime_versions = []
    for name in (
        "receive-review-continuation.cjs", "receive-prepared-review.mjs",
        "receive_review.py", "receive_current.py", "scf_native_process.py", "README.md",
    ):
        latest = Path(__file__).with_name(name)
        target = runtime / name
        selected_body = latest.read_bytes()
        target.write_bytes(selected_body)
        target.chmod(0o600)
        runtime_versions.append({"path": name, "bytes": len(selected_body), "sha256": digest(selected_body)})
    actual_runtime = record_runtime_selection(runtime, case, preceding_runtime)
    driver = runtime / ("receive-prepared-review.mjs" if args.engine == "native" else "receive-review-continuation.cjs")
    config.update(sourceRoot=str(case / "source"), outputDirectory=str(output),
                  previousOutputDirectory=str(previous), temporaryDirectory=str(temporary),
                  nodeModules=str(args.node_modules) if args.node_modules else None,
                  chromium=str(args.chromium) if args.chromium else None, port=0)
    config_path = case / "review-continuation-config.json"
    write_json(config_path, config)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update(TMPDIR=str(temporary), TEMP=str(temporary), TMP=str(temporary),
                       PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
    print("SCF_REVIEW_RESUME_START " + json.dumps({
        "operationId": OPERATION, "root": str(root), "engine": args.engine,
        "retainedMembers": members, "materializedMembers": materialized,
        "sourceCommit": config["sourceCommit"],
        "nativeRecord": str(output / "native-process.json"),
        "previousRuntime": preceding_runtime,
    }), flush=True)
    native, result = run_receiving_program(
        OPERATION, root, output,
        {"source_commit": config["sourceCommit"],
         "original_case": {"bytes": original_case_bytes, "sha256": selected_hash},
         "runtime_selection": actual_runtime, "retained_attempt": str(attempt),
         "retired_members": retired,
         "original_review_id": "SCF-TECHNICAL-BUYER-REVIEW-7108-20261012",
         "original_publication_operation": "SCF-GRANT-REVIEWER-PUBLICATION-8910-20261012",
         "library_replacement": {
             "library_file_id": args.replace_library_file_id,
             "expected_version": args.expected_library_version,
         }},
        args.node, args.chromium, driver, config_path, case, environment,
        args.timeout_seconds, args.engine + "-review", engine=args.engine,
    )
    state = native["state"]
    process_phases = native["phases"]
    native.update({
        "process_phases": process_phases,
        "phases": [

            "sha256": file_digest(archive)}

    if args.save_library or args.replace_library_file_id:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("original_receiver", runtime / "receive_current.py")

                       if args.replace_library_file_id else None)

"""Receive current source in the original saved SCF case and streaming controller."""
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
import zipfile

from scf_native_process import (
    preserve_console, record_runtime_selection, retain_runtime_edition, run_receiving_program,
)

OPERATION = "SCF-GRANT-CURRENT-REVIEW-81CF-20261012"
PHASE = "SCF-SUBMISSION-SOURCE-PACKAGE-A8CE-20261012"

def digest(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()

def git_blob(body):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(body)).encode() + b"\0" + body).hexdigest()

def source_bytes(row):
    content = row["content"]
    if not isinstance(content, str):
        raise ValueError("Retain a complete encoded source string: " + row["path"])
    encoding = row.get("encoding", "utf-8")
    if encoding in (None, "utf-8"):
        return content.encode("utf-8")
    if encoding == "base64":
        body = base64.b64decode(content, validate=True)
        if base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii") != content:
            raise ValueError("Retain canonical complete base64 source: " + row["path"])
        return body
    raise ValueError("Select UTF-8 or base64 source encoding: " + row["path"])

def checked_body(row):
    body = source_bytes(row)
    if len(body) != row["bytes"] or digest(body) != row["sha256"] or git_blob(body) != row["git_blob"]:
        raise ValueError("Complete selected source differs: " + row["path"])
    return body

def replace_bytes(path, body):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".new")
    temporary.write_bytes(body)
    temporary.chmod(0o600)
    temporary.replace(path)

def copy_source(source, destination):
    try:
        os.link(source, destination)
    except OSError:
        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    return str(destination)

def receive_source(args, original):
    selected = args.source_input.read_bytes()
    if digest(selected) != args.expected_source_input_sha256:
        raise ValueError("Receive the complete selected current-source input.")
    packet = json.loads(selected)
    if packet.get("schema") != "stellar-forge.current-source-receiving-input.v1":
        raise ValueError("Select the complete current-source receiving input.")
    if packet.get("operationId") != OPERATION or packet.get("phaseId") != PHASE:
        raise ValueError("Continue the original SCF operation and source phase.")
    source_package = packet["sourcePackage"]
    package_body = source_package["content"].encode("utf-8")
    if len(package_body) != source_package["bytes"] or digest(package_body) != source_package["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The complete selected reviewer package differs.")
    original_case = packet["originalCase"]
    if args.replace_library_file_id and args.replace_library_file_id != original_case["libraryId"]:
        raise ValueError("Continue the same saved customer case.")
    baseline = packet["baseline"]
    source_edition = packet["sourceSelection"]["id"]
    if len(source_edition) != 64 or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in source_edition):
        raise ValueError("Select the complete source edition identity.")

    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="scf-current-source-", dir=args.parent))
    case, private, temporary = root / "case", root / "private", root / "tmp"
    for directory in (case, private, temporary):
        directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    preserve_console(root / "producer-console.log")
    receiving_directory = packet.get("receivingDirectory", "receiving/source-package-continuation")
    receiving_directory = str(original.relative_path(receiving_directory))
    if packet.get("precedingSourceDirectory"):
        basis = packet.get("receivingBasis", {})
        basis_body = (json.dumps(basis, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
        receiving_id = digest(basis_body)
        if (packet.get("receivingId") != receiving_id or
                receiving_directory != "receiving/source-package-editions/" + receiving_id or
                basis.get("sourceSelection") != source_edition):
            raise ValueError("Continue the exact selected following edition and baseline.")
    elif receiving_directory != "receiving/source-package-continuation":
        raise ValueError("Retain the original first source receiving directory.")
    prefix = receiving_directory + "/"
    additional = {
        str(original.relative_path(baseline[key]))
        for key in ("draftPath", "reviewPath", "recordPath", "resultPath", "browserRecordPath")
        if key in baseline
    }
    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.case) as archive:
        additional.update(name for name in archive.namelist()
                          if name.startswith(prefix) and not name.endswith("/"))
    members, materialized = original.unpack_case(
        args.case, case, native_review=True, additional_members=additional)
    config = json.loads((case / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    previous = case / "receiving"
    output = case / receiving_directory
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    phase_config = output / "config.json"
    saved_config = json.loads(phase_config.read_text()) if phase_config.is_file() else None
    if saved_config and (saved_config.get("sourcePackageSha256") != source_package["sha256"] or
                         saved_config.get("sourceSelection", {}).get("id") != source_edition):
        raise ValueError("Continue the selected saved source phase before receiving another source edition.")
    if not saved_config and (args.case.stat().st_size != original_case["bytes"] or
                             original.file_digest(args.case) != original_case["sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("The first source phase requires its exact selected original case.")
    if args.expected_library_version is not None and not saved_config:
        if args.expected_library_version != original_case["version"]:
            raise ValueError("The first source phase requires the selected original saved version.")

    retired = {}
    attempt = output / "attempts" / (
        time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime()) + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8])
    for name in ("RESULT.json", "prepared-native-progress.json", "native-process.log",
                 "native-process.json", "javascript-parse.log", "node-version.log",
                 "independent-native-receiving.log", "producer-console.log",
                 "SOURCE_RECEIVING_INCOMPLETE.json", "native-result.json"):
        source = output / name
        if source.is_file():
            attempt.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
            target = attempt / name
            retired[source.relative_to(case).as_posix()] = target.relative_to(case).as_posix()
            source.replace(target)

    # Retain the complete former selection and its absolute native configuration.
    # Both are already read before moving, and every prior member keeps its bytes.
    for source, name in ((case / "runtime-selection.json", "runtime-selection.json"),
                         (phase_config, "source-phase-config.json")):
        if source.is_file():
            attempt.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
            target = attempt / name
            retired[source.relative_to(case).as_posix()] = target.relative_to(case).as_posix()
            source.replace(target)

    runtime = case / "runtime"
    preceding_runtime = retain_runtime_edition(runtime, case)
    runtime_rows = []
    for row in packet["runtime"]:
        name = str(original.relative_path(row["path"]))
        if "/" in name:
            raise ValueError("Select an original receiving runtime sibling.")
        body = Path(__file__).with_name(name).read_bytes()
        if len(body) != row["bytes"] or digest(body) != row["sha256"] or git_blob(body) != row["git_blob"]:
            raise ValueError("The native receiving runtime differs: " + name)
        replace_bytes(runtime / name, body)
        runtime_rows.append({key: row[key] for key in ("path", "bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")})
    actual_runtime = record_runtime_selection(runtime, case, preceding_runtime)

    # Original source remains in its original directory. Changed files replace
    # hard links atomically in the following complete source edition.
    original_source = case / "source"
    source_root = case / "source-editions" / source_edition / "source"
    source_root.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    shutil.copytree(original_source, source_root, copy_function=copy_source)
    rows = {row["path"]: dict(row) for row in config["files"]}
    for row in packet["assets"]:
        relative = original.relative_path(row["path"])
        body = checked_body(row)
        replace_bytes(source_root.joinpath(*relative.parts), body)
        rows[row["path"]] = {key: row[key] for key in ("path", "bytes", "sha256", "git_blob")}
    package_path = output / "source-package-input.json"
    replace_bytes(package_path, package_body)
    envelope = json.loads(package_body)
    received = envelope["received"]
    objects = {row["sha256"]: row for row in received["objects"]}
    expected_roles = {
        "application": "application.md", "source-index": "source-index.json",
        "budget": "budget.csv", "product-and-finance": "product-and-finance.md",
    }
    files = received["bundle"]["body"]["files"]
    if len(files) != 4 or {row["role"] for row in files} != set(expected_roles):
        raise ValueError("Receive all four complete original reviewer files.")
    for row in files:
        if row["name"] != expected_roles[row["role"]]:
            raise ValueError("Retain the selected original reviewer file names.")
        stored = objects[row["sha256"]]
        body = base64.b64decode(stored["base64"], validate=True)
        if len(body) != row["bytes"] or len(body) != stored["bytes"] or digest(body) != row["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The complete reviewer object differs: " + row["name"])
        relative = "stellar-forge/developer-site/dist/grant-data/" + row["name"]
        replace_bytes(source_root / relative, body)
        rows[relative] = {"path": relative, "bytes": len(body),
                          "sha256": digest(body), "git_blob": git_blob(body)}
    source_manifest = {
        "schema": "stellar-forge.current-source-edition.v1", "operationId": OPERATION,
        "phaseId": PHASE, "selection": packet["sourceSelection"],
        "originalSourceCommit": config["sourceCommit"],
        "sourcePackageSha256": source_package["sha256"],
        "files": [rows[key] for key in sorted(rows)],
    }
    original.write_json(source_root.parent / "manifest.json", source_manifest)
    phase_time = (datetime.fromisoformat(saved_config["at"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                  if saved_config else datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    if phase_time.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError("Retain the original phase time with its UTC offset.")
    at = phase_time.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
    current = {
        "operationId": OPERATION, "phaseId": PHASE, "at": at,
        "draftId": baseline["draftId"], "reviewId": baseline["reviewId"],
        "actorId": baseline["actorId"], "previousReviewEvents": baseline["reviewEvents"],
        "sourceRecords": source_package["sourceRecords"],
        "sourcePackageSha256": source_package["sha256"],
        "sourcePackagePath": str(package_path), "sourceRoot": str(source_root),
        "sourceSelection": packet["sourceSelection"],
        "originalDraftPath": str(case / baseline["draftPath"]),
        "originalReviewPath": str(case / baseline["reviewPath"]),
        "originalRecordPath": str(case / baseline["recordPath"]),
        "originalBrowserRecordPath": str(case / baseline.get("browserRecordPath", baseline["recordPath"])),
        "caseRoot": str(case), "receivingDirectory": receiving_directory,
        "precedingSourceDirectory": packet.get("precedingSourceDirectory"),
        "baseline": baseline,
        "originalResultPath": str(case / baseline["resultPath"]),
        "outputDirectory": str(output), "temporaryDirectory": str(temporary),
        "nodeModules": str(args.node_modules) if args.node_modules else None,
        "chromium": str(args.chromium) if args.chromium else None,
        "sourceInputSha256": args.expected_source_input_sha256,
    }
    if packet.get("preparedReview"):
        prepared = packet["preparedReview"]
        prepared_body = prepared["content"].encode("utf-8")
        if len(prepared_body) != prepared["bytes"] or digest(prepared_body) != prepared["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Retain the complete original authored current review.")
        prepared_path = output / "prepared-application-review.json"
        replace_bytes(prepared_path, prepared_body)
        current.update(preparedReviewPath=str(prepared_path),
                       preparedReviewSha256=prepared["sha256"])
    original.write_json(phase_config, current)
    replace_bytes(output / "complete-current-source-input.json", selected)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment.update(TMPDIR=str(temporary), TEMP=str(temporary), TMP=str(temporary),
                       PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
    context = {
        "source_selection": packet["sourceSelection"],
        "source_package": {key: source_package[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256", "sourceRecords")},
        "original_case": {"bytes": args.case.stat().st_size, "sha256": args.expected_case_sha256},
        "runtime_selection": actual_runtime, "retained_attempt": str(attempt),
        "retired_members": retired, "original_review_id": baseline["reviewId"],
        "original_publication_operation": "SCF-GRANT-REVIEWER-PUBLICATION-8910-20261012",
        "library_replacement": {"library_file_id": args.replace_library_file_id,
                                "expected_version": args.expected_library_version},
    }
    print("SCF_SOURCE_RESUME_START " + json.dumps({
        "operationId": OPERATION, "phaseId": PHASE, "root": str(root),
        "retainedMembers": members, "materializedMembers": materialized,
        "sourceRecords": source_package["sourceRecords"], "sourceFiles": len(rows),
        "originalReviewActions": baseline["reviewEvents"],
        "nativeRecord": str(output / "native-process.json"),
    }), flush=True)
    native, result = run_receiving_program(
        OPERATION, root, output, context, args.node, None,
        runtime / "receive-source-package.mjs", phase_config, case, environment,
        args.timeout_seconds, "current-source-receiving", engine="native",
    )
    native.update({
        "schema": "stellar-forge.source-package-continuation-native.v1",
        "phaseId": PHASE, "sourceRecords": source_package["sourceRecords"],
        "receivingDirectory": receiving_directory,
        "sourceFiles": len(rows), "sourceSelection": packet["sourceSelection"],
        "originalCase": context["original_case"], "runtime": runtime_rows,
        "retainedMembers": members, "materializedMembers": materialized,
        "originalDraftId": result.get("originalDraftId") if result else None,
        "originalReviewId": result.get("originalReviewId") if result else None,
        "reviewActions": result.get("reviewActions") if result else None,
        "reviewStatus": result.get("reviewStatus") if result else None,
    })
    state = native["state"]
    original.write_json(output / "native-result.json", native)
    archive = root / ("SCF-Current-Application-and-Review" +
                      ("" if state == "COMPLETE" else "-Partial") + ".zip")
    original.archive_case(args.case, case, archive, output, retired)
    metadata = {"path": str(archive), "bytes": archive.stat().st_size,
                "sha256": original.file_digest(archive)}
    print("SCF_REVIEW_RESUME_RESULT " + json.dumps({**native, "archive": metadata}), flush=True)
    if args.save_library or args.replace_library_file_id:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("original_receiver", runtime / "receive_current.py")
        receiver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(receiver)
        replacement = ((args.replace_library_file_id, args.expected_library_version)
                       if args.replace_library_file_id else None)
        saved = receiver.save_outputs(runtime, [archive], private, replacement)
        if not saved["all_saved"]:
            return 2
    return 0 if state == "COMPLETE" else 1

# Regional labor analysis and recurring customer delivery

## Customer problem and usable product

A regional economic-development team needs to explain changes in resident employment, workplace jobs and wages without losing the original statistical definitions. Its recurring work includes receiving official releases, selecting the same geography and periods, checking changes, writing a county briefing, and handing another analyst enough material to update the next edition.

The maintained **BLS regional labor workspace** implements that whole operating project. The selected product is `bls-labor`; Applications opens **BLS regional labor workspace** from the original initialized or received project. Its source engine retains complete Bureau of Labor Statistics files, dictionaries, footnotes and acquisition receipts. The analyst workspace adds source editions, complete observation browsing, county reports, complete regional calculations and charts, source comparisons, revisioned notes and editable project receiving. Its native controller reuses the existing publisher, dataset version store and SF88/Vitality customer receiving.

The complete regional product is merged in [Merchant PR951](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/951), at `8a9c1240a2cbb6600683e9ee27e5d70fcd361011`. The [operating guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/8a9c1240a2cbb6600683e9ee27e5d70fcd361011/products/bls-labor/OPERATING.md) is the exact installation, source-intake and customer-receiving entry. The [native publication guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/8a9c1240a2cbb6600683e9ee27e5d70fcd361011/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/bls-labor/workspace/NATIVE_RECEIVING.md) supplies the original host configuration and saved-operation interface.

## Original regional case

The retained Northeast Kingdom source covers Caledonia, Essex and Orleans in Vermont, with county FIPS 50005, 50009 and 50019. The original source archive is `NEK_Vitality_Official_Sources_20261011.zip`, 21,024,420 bytes, SHA-256 `3473bd56195b486c41a5042f5d9be4cfbf82bcf0d257528fe724b18caea9a28e`. The original native intake contains 408 LAUS observations and 96 QCEW observations. Within LAUS, 396 values are reported and 12 are unavailable. These original counts identify the retained case alongside the complete source and capture identities. LAUS describes the resident labor market; QCEW describes employment and wages at the place of work. The product keeps those populations and measures in separate original projections.

The original [BLS publisher case](https://tokenjunkielabs.slack.com/archives/C0BTB4SUCP9/p1791850294749669) carries the complete input, executable receiving command and original 4BF5/Actions operation. ## Reviewer journey

Start in the existing Runtime workspace and build the `bls-labor` selection from the merged source. Receive the resulting complete product archive through the existing runtime installer. Applications then selects the initialized or received analyst directory and the existing Python executable. Its Review, Save, Connect, Review Start, Start and Open controls preserve the selected source, workspace marker and actual native listener.

| Open resident-labor observations | Every selected LAUS row, exact source status, physical-record reference, raw value and original definition | Original typed LAUS projection and full-row observation view |

A reviewer can inspect one county's resident labor and workplace reports without treating their populations as interchangeable. For the prior-year resident-labor comparison, the application requires matching series, source period, units, residence basis, seasonal status and annual coverage. Rate differences remain percentage-point changes. Unavailable or incomparable values retain the original status or the reason a comparison could not be made. The current source dictionary and retained file remain available beside the result.

The original seven briefings remain resident-labor and workplace reports for each county, plus the resident-labor change report. The complete receiving programme also prepares the regional labor/workplace analysis and its saved customer-commentary revision. Every regional output includes the full original observation population, exact fractional calculations, all-row JSON and CSV, printable HTML charts, revision differences and a complete analysis ZIP. Full value paging and definition reopening are available in the same browser.

The regional unemployment rate uses total unemployed residents divided by total civilian labor force. QCEW regional employment adds distinct county jobs within one original ownership, industry and size group; regional weekly wages use quarterly wages and all three monthly employment counts. Original county rates and wage averages remain their published values. Missing or suppressed members leave the requested regional figure unavailable, and annual comparisons retain source coverage. The [complete method and customer guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/8a9c1240a2cbb6600683e9ee27e5d70fcd361011/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/bls-labor/workspace/REGIONAL_ANALYSIS.md) describes the calculations and links the original BLS definitions.

## Customer delivery and continuation

The same source edition can publish LAUS, QCEW and the complete original files through the maintained data publisher. The analyst selects an actual reviewer, the review note, projections and any original plan or run IDs. A saved request binds the operation to the full source identity. The controller opens or reuses the original publisher and dataset services, retains the completed review and publication results, and continues the original SF88 acquisition and Vitality import when that customer receiving is selected.

The portable customer project carries its source editions, datasets, reports, note history, saved requests and native results. A receiving host supplies its own connection and can continue the same working project. A completed original delivery remains in history; a new publication uses a newly selected operation.

The complete project ZIP is the practical handover. ## Place in the funded programme

This existing implementation is a concrete customer-facing foundation for the current six-package SCF plan. The recurring service is specific: receive the next official release, preserve prior editions, explain comparable changes, update county commentary, publish the selected complete datasets, and deliver updated reports plus the editable project. Its service boundaries are the selected geography, projections, source periods, review responsibilities and customer delivery format. Commercial commitments are agreed for the customer's actual assignment and capacity.

full toolkit or a reviewed product selection containing both `merchant-mcp`
and the `merchant-grant-reviewer` contribution.

Save the original and receiving directories under named aliases in a private
`stellar-forge.grant-reviewer-merchant-connection.v1` JSON file. An alias with
`allowStart: false` borrows the workbench already opened by Applications;
`allowStart: true` permits an explicit start of that same original workbench.
The complete guide supplies the exact connection fields and source-file pins.

~~~sh
starforge merchant-grant-reviewer init --directory /srv/starforge/reviewer-merchant \
  --connection /srv/starforge/private/reviewer-connections.json
starforge merchant-mcp serve --config /srv/starforge/reviewer-merchant/merchant-mcp.json \
  --port 3211 --token-env MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN
~~~

The twenty `merchant_grant_reviewer_` operations provide source review and
receiving, current Buyer lifecycle, original quote/history/result reading,
complete document retrieval, closed-view export and full-file receiving.
The typed `@tokenjunkielabs/starforge-merchant/grant/reviewer-merchant` client
uses the same contracts; its CLI supports calls, local-file review, inspection,
interrupted-download continuation and local cold reopening.

Retain the request UUID with each action. After a lost reply, inspect or repeat
that original action with the same input. An exported file keeps its complete
manifest, original workbench identity, byte count and SHA-256 as the merchant
host restarts. The receiver resumes the original saved download directory and
checks every file before reopening it.

Merchant shutdown releases its readers and its own workbenches. An
Applications-owned workbench remains with that original owner. The private
Buyer code stays in its original host connection.

This standalone edition includes the complete source from
[public PR1984](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/public-commons-sprint-2026/pull/1984),
merge `ddde47d69aac27cae5021a17bc6b3d15d43fc884`. The complete
[merchant receiving continuation](../../stellar/scf_2026/presentation/reviewer/merchant/RECEIVING.mjs)
extends the same original closed reviewer operation and both saved result files.
The Console continuation follows that same operation and its existing merchant
journal through complete customer delivery and independent receiving.

## Complete customer delivery in the operator workspace

The `grant-reviewer` product selection includes both **Grant purchase reviewer**
and **Merchant operator** in Applications. Keep the original workbench open
through its owning application. Initialize its merchant connection with the
command above, then save **Merchant operator** using that
`merchant-mcp.json`, a private saved operator directory and the original token
environment name. **Review Start → Start → Open** leads to the authenticated
operator workspace on that same merchant listener.

The direct command opens the same workspace:

~~~sh
starforge merchant-mcp serve \
  --config /srv/starforge/reviewer-merchant/merchant-mcp.json \
  --operator-console-dir /srv/starforge/reviewer-merchant/operator-console \
  --port 3211 --token-env MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN
~~~

Select or create a named profile, then open **Customers → Reviewer customer
delivery**. Work through the five sections:

1. Load the configured workbench aliases and open the original source state.
2. Review the bundled purchase, a declared host file, or a complete local packet.
   Inspect the saved selection and its revision before receiving it.
3. Open the original Buyer and read its complete saved history, both quote
   outcomes, full result files and source documents.
4. Close the Buyer and export the selected packet. **Receive these original
   files** retains its complete manifest and every original file in Customers.
   Download the full receiving packet, or choose an individual retained file.
5. Prepare the complete delivery or receiving recipe. The existing Workflow
   Recipes editor reviews its actual inputs and native contracts, then installs
   a named immutable workflow edition.

The delivery recipe has fourteen native steps, with pauses at source inspection,
the complete saved result, closed export, receiving review and received history.
The six-step receiving recipe starts from an existing reviewed export. Its
destination is another configured workbench. Each original action UUID stays
with its saved request; a lost response continues that request and revision.

A completed workflow export can be reopened in Customers with its exact
workbench alias, export ID and manifest SHA-256. Receiving resumes the retained
file checkpoints after interruption. The complete packet remains
`grant-reviewer-packet.json`; its accompanying manifest and operation file are
also available individually.

**Export profile** carries the original requests, workflow installation and run,
complete customer identities and immutable host-binding history. The receiving
operator imports that history into its own retained Console, then receives the
original files from the selected export. After a host change, **Host → Review
host** compares the actual configured tools and declarations before the operator
saves the displayed binding.

The [complete Reviewer Customer Delivery guide](../../stellar-forge/mcp-merchant-operator/console/CUSTOMER_REVIEWER.md)
includes the exact recipe inputs, response recovery, full-file controls and
original native receiving continuation. The
[Merchant operator Applications guide](../../stellar-forge/mcp-merchant-operator/console/APPLICATIONS.md)
covers saved launch, current private Open, drained Stop and cold reopen.

## Read the scientific report-product architecture

The [development guide](../merchant-workspace/DEVELOPMENT.md#frozen-scientific-reports-as-merchant-resources)
now connects the complete Groundwater report product to the same native seller,
buyer and Operations boundaries. The upstream
[operator guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/public-commons-sprint-2026/blob/9b6b92c2c290b73ca6e263d28603fdcad3a19bf6/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/groundwater-report/OPERATOR.md)
covers exact frozen report assets and terms, original buyer preparation,
full-package verification, an attributed file decision, optional selected-case
association and complete report-desk receiving.

Review this as a distinct delivered software capability. Its exact source,
Linux request recovery and complete control-desk restore have been verified;
its scientific report/portal operation is still being continued from the
original generated-package reference finding. A successful source check is
not a completed report sale or customer receiving decision.

The NYC HPD reviewer packet, both quote outcomes, original result bytes and
existing purchase/receiving operation above remain unchanged. Read the new
report workflow from its own actual frozen report and explicitly authorized
buyer evidence when those records are available. The
[Operations guide](../grant-operations/OPERATING.md#frozen-groundwater-report-receiving)
describes the precise case/deployment/purchase selection. Neither this
architecture addition nor opening its source creates another purchase.

## Receive the issuer programme with the application

Open **Prepare submission → Submission handover → Issuer programme and selected native plan** to receive the complete original issuer case from Grant Operations. Review the original correspondence, saved terms and native commissioning, record the receiving context, and select its exact native plan when ready to review that plan in the application. Prepared editions freeze the context while the complete editable draft retains every original byte and prior edition.

The command-line equivalent is `starforge grant-export --draft saved-submission.json --receive-issuer-case complete-issuer-case.zip --issuer-profile issuer-profile.json --out /private/new-export`. The explicit profile selects whether to receive the case's native plan. See [the complete issuer receiving guide](../../stellar-forge/developer-site/GRANT_ISSUER_CONTEXT.md) for the full browser, CLI, file and handover flow.

## Search a retained catalog and receive its original request

The grant application's **Search the catalog** opening operates the complete
October 12, 2026 Vellar page: 27 resources, original declarations and payment
alternatives. Load the source, apply a query and exact filters, inspect a result,
then prepare and download its complete catalog review JSON.

In the installed **Atlas** application, expand **Receive a catalog review**.
Choose the full file, inspect the original source and selected terms, and select
**Receive and open this request**. The original Atlas editor continues explicit
URL, method, header, body/ticket preparation and its maintained buyer handoff.
The configured buyer remains responsible for its current service and approval.

The saved request can download its original review; complete Atlas workspace
export and receiving carry that review with the capture and request revisions.
This source review uses the catalog's own advertised USDC alternatives. The
original testnet XLM purchase and result described in the preceding sections
retain their separate operated history.

The focused `grant-reviewer` package includes Atlas, `atlas-workspace` and the
typed `catalog/atlas/review` and `catalog/atlas/search` exports. See the installed
`stellar-forge/developer-site/GRANT_CATALOG.md` and
`stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf61-bazaar-explorer/CATALOG_REVIEW.md` guides for the
complete browser, CLI, API and cold-receiving workflow.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""AgentSmith source capture and native Commons buyer preparation. MIT."""
import argparse
import base64
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import fcntl
from contextlib import contextmanager
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import stat
import uuid
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from urllib.request import HTTPRedirectHandler, Request, build_opener

NETWORK = "stellar:testnet"
ASSET = "CBIELTK6YBZJU5UP2WWQEUCYKLPU6AUNZ2BQ4WWFEIE3USCIHMXQDAMA"
SELLER = "https://agentsmith.xyz/metar/v1/metar"
FACILITATOR = "https://agentsmith.xyz/facilitator"
MAX_CAPTURE = 1048576
SCHEMA = "commons.agentsmith.source-capture.v1"
NATIVE = Path("stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/cli.mjs")


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode()


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def https(value):
    parsed = urlsplit(value)
    need(parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname and not parsed.username
         and not parsed.password and not parsed.fragment, "Public HTTPS URL required")
    return value


def write_new(path, data):
    """Publish complete bytes with the original create-only contract."""
    temporary = path.with_name("." + path.name + "." + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".tmp")
    owned = False
    try:
        fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
        owned = True
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.link(temporary, path, follow_symlinks=False)
        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
        try:
            os.fsync(directory_fd)
        finally:
            os.close(directory_fd)
    finally:
        if owned:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def retain_exact(path, data):
    """Reuse completed bytes directly, including on a nearly full filesystem."""
    try:
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        try:
            write_new(path, data)
            return
        except FileExistsError:
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not info.st_mode & 0o077
             and info.st_size == len(data), "Retained file differs: " + path.name)
        need(stream.read(len(data) + 1) == data, "Retained bytes differ: " + path.name)


@contextmanager
def output_operation(directory):
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    info = directory.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not info.st_mode & 0o077
         and info.st_uid == os.getuid(), "Use the original private output directory")
    fd = os.open(directory / ".receiving.lock",
                 os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        lock_info = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(lock_info.st_mode) and not lock_info.st_mode & 0o077,
             "Original receiving lock must be private")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            raise ValueError("The original receiving operation is already running")
        yield
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


class NoRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        return None


def read_http(url, method, body=None):
    req = Request(https(url), data=body, method=method,
                  headers={"Accept": "application/json",
                           "Content-Type": "application/json",
                           "User-Agent": "TokenJunkieLabs-AgentSmith-Integration/1.0"})
    try:
        response = build_opener(NoRedirect()).open(req, timeout=25)
    except HTTPError as error:
        response = error
    with response:
        data = response.read(MAX_CAPTURE + 1)
        need(len(data) <= MAX_CAPTURE, "Response exceeds capture limit")
        return {"url": url, "method": method,
                "retrievedAt": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "status": response.status,
                "headers": dict((k.lower(), v) for k, v in response.headers.items()),
                "bodyUtf8": data.decode("utf-8"), "bodySha256": sha(data)}


def select_offer(challenge, url):
    need(challenge.get("x402Version") == 2, "x402 version 2 required")
    need(challenge.get("resource", {}).get("url") == url,
         "Original challenge resource must match the requested URL exactly")
    offers = challenge.get("accepts")
    need(isinstance(offers, list) and 0 < len(offers) <= 32, "Original offers required")
    selected = []
    for index, offer in enumerate(offers):
        if (offer.get("scheme") == "exact" and offer.get("network") == NETWORK
                and offer.get("asset") == ASSET
                and offer.get("extra", {}).get("areFeesSponsored") is True):
            need(re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", str(offer.get("amount", ""))),
                 "Positive atomic amount required")
            need(re.fullmatch(r"[GC][A-Z2-7]{55}", str(offer.get("payTo", ""))),
                 "Stellar recipient required")
            need(type(offer.get("maxTimeoutSeconds")) is int
                 and 1 <= offer["maxTimeoutSeconds"] <= 86400,
                 "Native authorization lifetime required")
            need(offer.get("extra", {}).get("paymentFlow", "authorization") == "authorization",
                 "This receiving recipe selects authorization payment flow")
            selected.append(index)
    need(len(selected) == 1, "Exactly one sponsored exact testnet USDC offer required")
    return selected[0]


def capture(args):
    directory = Path(args.directory).resolve()
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    body = Path(args.body_file).read_bytes() if args.body_file else encoded({"icao": args.icao})
    need(0 < len(body) <= 16777216, "Native request must contain 1 byte to 16 MiB")
    request_json = json.loads(body)
    need(isinstance(request_json, dict), "The selected JSON request must be an object")
    write_new(directory / "request.json", body)
    supported = read_http(args.facilitator.rstrip("/") + "/supported", "GET")
    write_new(directory / "supported.http.json", encoded(supported))
    response = read_http(args.url, "POST", body)
    response["requestBodySha256"] = sha(body)
    response["requestBodyBytes"] = len(body)
    write_new(directory / "challenge.http.json", encoded(response))
    return complete_capture(directory, body, supported, response, args.url, args.facilitator)


def complete_capture(directory, body, supported, response, url, facilitator, *, resume=False):
    retain = retain_exact if resume else write_new
    need(supported["status"] == 200, "Facilitator supported response must be HTTP 200")
    kinds = json.loads(supported["bodyUtf8"]).get("kinds", [])
    need(any(k.get("x402Version") == 2 and k.get("scheme") == "exact"
             and k.get("network") == NETWORK
             and k.get("extra", {}).get("areFeesSponsored") is True for k in kinds),
         "Facilitator must advertise sponsored exact Stellar testnet")
    need(response["status"] == 402, "Seller must return the actual unpaid HTTP 402")
    header = response["headers"].get("payment-required", "")
    need(0 < len(header) <= 262144, "Original PAYMENT-REQUIRED header required")
    challenge_bytes = base64.b64decode(header, validate=True)
    challenge = json.loads(challenge_bytes)
    index = select_offer(challenge, url)
    retain(directory / "payment-required.json", challenge_bytes)
    # Only the envelope changes. Preserve the entire original challenge as its row.
    retain(directory / "offers.json", encoded({"resources": [challenge]}))
    names = ["request.json", "supported.http.json", "challenge.http.json",
             "payment-required.json", "offers.json"]
    manifest = {"schema": SCHEMA, "seller": url, "method": "POST",
                "facilitator": facilitator, "network": NETWORK,
                "capturedAt": response["retrievedAt"], "rowIndex": 0,
                "acceptIndex": index, "selectedOffer": challenge["accepts"][index],
                "files": {name: {"sha256": sha((directory / name).read_bytes()),
                                 "bytes": (directory / name).stat().st_size} for name in names}}
    retain(directory / "capture.json", encoded(manifest))
    return {"status": "ORIGINAL_HTTP_SOURCE_CAPTURED", "directory": str(directory),
            "manifestSha256": sha((directory / "capture.json").read_bytes()),
            "selectedOffer": manifest["selectedOffer"]}


def restore(args):
    bundle = json.loads(Path(args.source).read_bytes())
    need(bundle.get("schema") == "commons.agentsmith.http-bundle.v1",
         "Original AgentSmith HTTP bundle required")
    supported, response = bundle["supported"], bundle["challenge"]
    body = bundle["requestUtf8"].encode("utf-8")
    need(response["requestBodySha256"] == sha(body)
         and response["requestBodyBytes"] == len(body), "Original request bytes changed")
    need(supported["bodySha256"] == sha(supported["bodyUtf8"].encode("utf-8"))
         and response["bodySha256"] == sha(response["bodyUtf8"].encode("utf-8")),
         "Original HTTP response bytes changed")
    url, facilitator = https(bundle["seller"]), https(bundle["facilitator"])
    need(response["url"] == url and response["method"] == "POST"
         and supported["url"] == facilitator.rstrip("/") + "/supported"
         and supported["method"] == "GET", "Original HTTP sources changed")
    directory = Path(args.directory).absolute()
    need(directory.resolve() == directory, "Use the original unaliased capture path")
    with output_operation(directory):
        retain_exact(directory / "request.json", body)
        retain_exact(directory / "supported.http.json", encoded(supported))
        retain_exact(directory / "challenge.http.json", encoded(response))
        return complete_capture(directory, body, supported, response, url, facilitator, resume=True)


def read_capture(directory):
    root = Path(directory).resolve()
    manifest = json.loads((root / "capture.json").read_bytes())
    need(manifest.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "Original capture schema required")
    for name, expected in manifest["files"].items():
        need(Path(name).name == name, "Capture file must remain inside its directory")
        data = (root / name).read_bytes()
        need(len(data) == expected["bytes"] and sha(data) == expected["sha256"],
             "Retained source bytes changed: " + name)
    response = json.loads((root / "challenge.http.json").read_bytes())
    body = (root / "request.json").read_bytes()
    need(response["status"] == 402 and response["requestBodySha256"] == sha(body)
         and response["requestBodyBytes"] == len(body), "Original HTTP request binding changed")
    challenge = json.loads((root / "payment-required.json").read_bytes())
    need(base64.b64decode(response["headers"]["payment-required"], validate=True)
         == (root / "payment-required.json").read_bytes(), "Original header bytes changed")
    need(json.loads((root / "offers.json").read_bytes()) == {"resources": [challenge]},
         "Native saved offer must carry the complete original challenge")
    index = select_offer(challenge, manifest["seller"])
    need(index == manifest["acceptIndex"]
         and challenge["accepts"][index] == manifest["selectedOffer"],
         "Selected source terms changed")
    return root, manifest


PREPARE_REVIEW_JS = """
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
const {prepareReview} = await import(pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href);
const result = prepareReview(await readFile(process.argv[2]), JSON.parse(process.argv[3]));
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({configSha256:result.configSha256,
    dataBase64:result.data.toString('base64')}));
"""


def prepare(args):
    root, manifest = read_capture(args.capture)
    checkout = Path(args.checkout).resolve()
    cli = checkout / NATIVE
    need(cli.is_file(), "Complete Commons checkout and original SF88 CLI required")
    need(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}", args.intent_id), "Stable intent ID required")
    output = Path(args.directory).absolute()
    need(output.resolve() == output, "Use the original unaliased request path")
    body = (root / "request.json").read_bytes()
    review_path = output / "review.json"
    record_path = output / "preparation.json"
    with output_operation(output):
        retain_exact(output / "request.json", body)
        # The original pure preparer binds a pre-existing draft before resuming
        # around the original create-only CLI. Request/output paths stay fixed.
        selection = {"rowIndex": manifest["rowIndex"], "acceptIndex": manifest["acceptIndex"],
                     "intentId": args.intent_id, "url": manifest["seller"], "method": "POST",
                     "bodyFile": str(output / "request.json"), "bodyBytes": len(body),
                     "bodySha256": sha(body), "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                     "responseOut": str(output / "metar-result.json")}
        derived = subprocess.run(
            [args.node, "--input-type=module", "-e", PREPARE_REVIEW_JS,
             str(cli.parent / "prepare.mjs"), str(root / "offers.json"),
             json.dumps(selection)], cwd=checkout, check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
        expected = json.loads(derived.stdout)
        config_bytes = base64.b64decode(expected["dataBase64"], validate=True)
        need(sha(config_bytes) == expected["configSha256"], "Original preparer result changed")
        prior_record = json.loads(record_path.read_bytes()) if record_path.exists() else None
        if prior_record is not None:
            need(prior_record.get("schema") == "commons.agentsmith.native-preparation.v1"
                 and prior_record.get("intentId") == args.intent_id
                 and prior_record.get("sourceDirectory") == str(root)
                 and prior_record.get("captureManifestSha256") == sha((root / "capture.json").read_bytes())
                 and prior_record.get("reviewConfigSha256") == sha(config_bytes),
                 "Reopen the original preparation and its stable intent")
        native_path = output / "native-prepare.json"
        if review_path.exists():
            retain_exact(review_path, config_bytes)
            if native_path.exists():
                native_result = json.loads(native_path.read_bytes())
                need(native_result.get("configPath") == str(review_path)
                     and native_result.get("configSha256") == sha(config_bytes),
                     "Original preparation result differs")
            else:
                # This is the actual original prepareReview result after a
                # completed draft survived interruption before its stdout saved.
                native_result = {"mode": "OFFLINE_CONFIG_REOPENED",
                                 "configPath": str(review_path),
                                 "configSha256": expected["configSha256"],
                                 "intentId": args.intent_id,
                                 "sourceFileSha256": sha((root / "offers.json").read_bytes())}
                retain_exact(native_path, encoded(native_result))
        else:
            need(prior_record is None and not native_path.exists(),
                 "Restore the original reviewed configuration before continuing")
            argv = [args.node, str(cli), "--prepare", "--discovery", str(root / "offers.json"),
                    "--row", str(manifest["rowIndex"]), "--accept", str(manifest["acceptIndex"]),
                    "--intent-id", args.intent_id, "--url", manifest["seller"], "--method", "POST",
                    "--body-file", str(output / "request.json"), "--content-type", "application/json",
                    "--response-out", str(output / "metar-result.json"), "--out", str(review_path)]
            result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=checkout, check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
            native_result = json.loads(result.stdout)
            retain_exact(review_path, config_bytes)
            retain_exact(native_path, encoded(native_result))
        reviewed = subprocess.run(
            [args.node, str(cli), "--review", "--config", str(review_path)],
            cwd=checkout, check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
        review = json.loads(reviewed.stdout)
        review_result = output / "native-review.json"
        if not review_result.exists():
            retain_exact(review_result, encoded(review))
        record = {"schema": "commons.agentsmith.native-preparation.v1",
                  "captureManifestSha256": sha((root / "capture.json").read_bytes()),
                  "checkout": str(checkout), "nativeCliSha256": sha(cli.read_bytes()),
                  "intentId": args.intent_id, "sourceDirectory": str(root),
                  "reviewConfig": str(review_path), "nativeResult": native_result,
                  "reviewConfigSha256": sha(config_bytes)}
        if prior_record is None:
            retain_exact(record_path, encoded(record))
        return {"status": "NATIVE_BUYER_REVIEW_REOPENED" if prior_record else "NATIVE_BUYER_REVIEW_PREPARED",
                "directory": str(output), "config": str(review_path),
                "intentId": args.intent_id, "nativeReview": review}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    capt = sub.add_parser("capture", help="Retain the actual facilitator and unpaid seller response")
    capt.add_argument("--directory", required=True)
    capt.add_argument("--url", type=https, default=SELLER)
    capt.add_argument("--facilitator", type=https, default=FACILITATOR)
    request = capt.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    request.add_argument("--body-file")
    request.add_argument("--icao", default="KJFK")
    prep = sub.add_parser("prepare", help="Call the original SF88 prepare and review commands")
    prep.add_argument("--capture", required=True)
    prep.add_argument("--checkout", required=True)
    prep.add_argument("--directory", required=True)
    prep.add_argument("--intent-id", required=True)
    prep.add_argument("--node", default="node")
    rest = sub.add_parser("restore", help="Receive a retained original HTTP bundle offline")
    rest.add_argument("--source", required=True)
    rest.add_argument("--directory", required=True)
    ins = sub.add_parser("inspect", help="Reopen and inspect the same retained source")
    ins.add_argument("--capture", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.command == "capture":
        result = capture(args)
    elif args.command == "prepare":
        result = prepare(args)
    elif args.command == "restore":
        result = restore(args)
    else:
        root, manifest = read_capture(args.capture)
        result = {"directory": str(root), **manifest}
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
        if isinstance(error, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
            print(error.stderr.strip(), file=sys.stderr)
        print(json.dumps({"error": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error),
                          "recovery": "Continue from the same retained capture and original intent."}),
              file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)

# Open the U.S. economic briefing

Open [the complete economic report](stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/fred/examples/briefing-20261012/briefing.html) in your browser. It works offline and carries its original observations, comparisons and source notes. No account, API key or merchant connection is required to read this saved edition.

## Read and reuse the report

The **Summary** tab shows the latest available observation in each selected series. **Measures** contains all 150 comparisons; select a series or calculation state to inspect its original current value, baseline, dates and units. **Sources & method** carries publisher metadata and the actual public-table retrieval dates. The report's **Download all measures** and **Download report data** buttons save the complete CSV and JSON locally.

The reporting window is January 2024 through September 2026. The full source has 2,219 observations; this report selects 75 and retains all 103 current/baseline observations needed for its comparisons. Of the 150 comparisons, 144 have both values, four retain a missing current value and two retain a missing baseline. Original missing values remain visible.

This is a retained October 2026 source edition. Its public-table retrieval basis is preserved; it is not an ALFRED historical-vintage selection or a live economic feed. Read each series' own source update and retrieval time before reusing its values.

| Series | How to read its changes |
| --- | --- |
| UNRATE | Original unemployment rate in percent. Absolute differences are **percentage points**. Relative percent change was not selected. |
| CPIAUCSL | Original monthly seasonally adjusted price index. Absolute differences keep the index units; relative changes use the selected exact period ratio. |
| GDP | Original nominal quarterly GDP in billions of dollars at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. The relative comparison is the direct ratio of the two published levels; it is not an annualized growth rate or real GDP growth. |

Absolute changes use exact decimal subtraction. Relative changes use the separately selected ratio and half-even rounding to six decimal places. The report does not resample dates or fill missing values. [The original operator guide](stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/fred/BRIEFINGS.md) explains every calculation state and baseline rule.

## Continue in the original FRED application

Use your existing Stellar Forge installation containing the analyst briefing feature and its original dependencies. The following original commands create a **new private example project**. Replace the absolute paths first. Keep the exported package immutable; place the project and generated delivery in separate private directories. Import uses the retained source capture and needs no FRED API key.

```sh

FRED_PROJECT=/absolute/private/economic-briefing
```
